newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Danish soldier killed in Bosnia road accident.
newsitem.headline: Danish soldier killed in Bosnia road accident.

text.p: A Danish soldier on NATO duty in Bosnia was killed on Friday and three were injured, one seriously, when their tank fell off a bridge while on patrol near Doboj, a NATO spokesman said.
A total of 53 soldiers have now been killed while deployed as part of the NATO-led peace force in Bosnia. None has died as a result of hostile fire.
As predicted by military planners before the deployment, most casualties have been the result of traffic accidents and mines.
"Early this morning at about 0130 (0030 GMT) a Danish Leopard tank flipped off a low bridge and into a river," Major Brett Boudreau told reporters in Sarajevo.
Two other Danish soldiers sustained minor injuries but a fourth was trapped under the vehicle and seriously hurt. The three injured Danes were taken to a nearby NATO field hospital for treatment.
Boudreau said weather was likely a contributing factor to the accident, which is under investigation. Snow and ice has made roads treacherous in many parts of Bosnia in recent days.
